title: CLI framework, result envelope, and exit codes
objective: Every CLI command emits the doc-04 result envelope in JSON mode with clean stdout, routes diagnostics to stderr, and maps failures through the doc-04 exit-code table via a single testable presentation boundary.
business_value: Later packages register many commands; without a shared envelope and exit-code layer each command reinvents serialization and automation cannot trust the output contract.
scope: Create a presentation module (new files, e.g. src/workctx/presentation/) providing: envelope builder {ok, command, context_id, result, warnings, errors, meta{schema_version, duration_ms}}, stdout/stderr console separation, duration capture, and a single exception-to-exit-code boundary

Implement the context-resolution shell of doc-04: a shared --context option (explicit path, precedence step 1) falling back to nearest-ancestor discovery (step 2) and a clear failure (step 4), reusing resolve_context_root unchanged; document the step-3 (user registry) seam for WP-200 in docs/reference/cli-envelope.md

workctx.errors: existing exception classes are frozen (services/contexts.py and validation/workspace.py import them); you may add new classes only — the exit-code boundary maps existing exceptions without renaming or restructuring them
result is always a JSON object: list-shaped payloads are wrapped (doctor uses {"checks": [...]})

Implement the exit-code mapping decided by the lead: 0 success; 1 validation/user-correctable (invalid context, init on non-empty dir); 2 usage/config (Click default preserved); 3 context boundary or permission denial; 4 conflict/stale precondition (reserved, mapped for future errors); 5 unavailable dependency (doctor required-check failure moves from 1 to 5); 6 partial success with stale derived state (reserved); 10 unexpected internal failure via top-level exception boundary

Rewire existing commands through the envelope: doctor --json, context inspect --json, context validate --json (and the top-level validate alias), context init (add --json and resolved-context print); version stays plain text per doc-04
In JSON mode nothing decorative reaches stdout; error details go into the envelope errors array and human diagnostics to stderr
Add empty typer sub-app scaffolding only where it clarifies the framework (do not pre-create all doc-04 families)
Add an envelope JSON Schema under schemas/cli-envelope.schema.json with ADR 0008 fixtures
Update tests/test_cli.py to the envelope shapes with split stdout/stderr assertions and exit-code coverage; the doctor monkeypatch-by-import-site pattern may need adjusting
non_goals: No business commands (inbox, artifact, proposal, transaction, search, ref, context-pack, task, brief, view, index, agent, mcp, dev)
No context-resolution step 3 implementation (user-level registry) — WP-200 owns discovery; you ship the documented seam only
No changes to services/contexts.py, validation/workspace.py, or models (consume frozen interfaces only)
Removing the top-level validate alias is out of scope: it stays (lead decision D-012)
deliverables: Presentation module with envelope, streams, timing, and exit-code boundary
All existing commands rewired through the envelope
docs/reference/cli-envelope.md documenting the contract including the kept validate alias
Updated CLI tests with split-stream and exit-code assertions
acceptance_criteria: Every --json output validates against cli-envelope.schema.json in tests
JSON mode stdout contains exactly one JSON document; diagnostics go to stderr (tests split streams)

Exit codes follow the contracted mapping, including doctor required-failure = 5 and an injected unexpected exception = 10; the mapper itself has unit tests covering every band (0-6, 10), including reserved codes 3, 4, and 6
--context resolves an explicit path with precedence over ancestor discovery; missing context fails with the doc-04 step-4 clear error; the step-3 seam is documented
context init supports --json and prints the resolved context target
duration_ms and schema_version appear in meta for every envelope
security_constraints: Error envelopes must not leak raw evidence content or secret-looking values; sanitize exception text at the boundary
No network access; no new runtime dependencies without a lead decision
stop_conditions: The envelope requires changing a frozen service signature or a WP-110/WP-100 file
Doc-04 semantics conflict with an existing test in a way not covered by this contract
